      method: cookie
    technology: {}
    structure: {}
  parameters: {}

diagnostics.afPlan:
env:
  contexts:
  - name: openapi-import-token
    urls:
    - http://localhost:9091/api/openapi/simple-token
    includePaths:
    - http://localhost:9091/api/openapi/simple-token.*
    authentication:
      method: manual
      verification:
        method: response
        loggedInRegex: HTTP\/\d\.\d 200
        loggedOutRegex: HTTP\/\d\.\d 403
  parameters: {}
jobs:
- name: record diagnostics
  type: diagnostics
  parameters:
    enabled: true
- name: add security token
  type: replacer
  rules:
  - description: Security token header
    url: http://localhost:9091/api/openapi/simple-token/.*
    matchType: req_header
    matchString: X-Security-Token
    replacementString: zap-test-security-token
  parameters:
    deleteAllRules: true
- name: import token protected definition
  type: openapi
  parameters:
    apiUrl: http://localhost:9091/api/openapi/simple-token/openapi.json
    context: openapi-import-token
  tests:
  - name: Endpoint imported and request with token succeeded
    type: url
    onFail: ERROR
    url: http://localhost:9091/api/openapi/simple-token/test-api
    responseHeaderRegex: HTTP\/\d\.\d 200
    operator: or
- name: auth report
  type: report
  parameters:
    template: auth-report-json
    reportFile: openapi-import-token
    reportTitle: ZAP by Checkmarx Scanning Report
